title: Application Stack Playbooks
objective: Sequence repositories, packages, configuration, applications, and services.

sourceAlignment.title: Ansible for DevOps, 2nd Edition
sourceAlignment.author: Jeff Geerling
sourceAlignment.note: Original Code Forge companion material; no book prose is reproduced.

paragraphs: Application servers typically need repositories, runtimes, source or release artifacts, configuration, service units, and health checks. Each layer should use a state-aware module.
LAMP and search stacks add databases, PHP or Java, dependency managers, templates, and application-specific installation commands. Variables keep versions and paths out of task logic.
explanation.rule: Operational rule: Sequence repositories, packages, configuration, applications, and services.
